old_value_note: <absent> — the leaf did not exist in the prior baseline

computation.step_1_what_Q2_is: Syndra has no second Q spell in the wiki cache; `data/champions.json` -> Syndra.abilities.Q holds a single spell 'Dark Sphere' whose second effect entry reads 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' The audit cache confirms the calculator models that stocked charge as a synthetic slot: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json -> Syndra.module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R], note 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)', and notable_atoms includes 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'. So Q2 is a second CAST of Dark Sphere, not a distinct ability.
computation.step_2_cost_per_cast: The wiki cache gives Dark Sphere exactly one cost track, per cast: cost.modifiers[0].values = [40, 45, 50, 55, 60], resource = MANA. It is a charge/recharge ability (rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7], cooldown.affectedByCdr = false), and nothing in the Q effects, blurb, or notes waives or discounts mana for a charge-stocked cast — the notes only say the stocked charges are shown as sphere icons under her health bar. Therefore every Dark Sphere cast, including one that consumes a stocked charge, costs the rank's mana.
computation.step_3_rank_at_level_11: Rank-unlock rules: a basic ability reaches rank 5 at champion level 9 (ranks 2/3/4/5 unlock at levels 3/5/7/9); the ultimate takes its 2nd point at level 11. At level 11 Syndra has 11 points, 2 in R, 9 in basics, so a Q-max-first baseline has Q at rank 5 — the maximum rank legal at that level.
computation.step_4_value: Q rank 5 mana cost = cost.values[4] = 60 -> Q2.resource_cost = 60.0.
computation.consistency_check: Because Q2 is the same spell cast a second time, its resource_cost must equal the sibling leaf /champion_baselines/Syndra/abilities_level_11/Q/resource_cost. 60.0 is the only value in the cost track consistent with a rank-5 (level-11-maxed) Q; a rank-4 reading would give 55.0, but rank 4 is not what a level-11 baseline with a maxed primary carries.
computation.why_old_absent_is_wrong: An absent resource_cost asserts the stocked second Dark Sphere is free to cast. The cached wiki text supports no such waiver: the Transcendent Bonus grants a charge only, and the single per-cast cost track applies to every cast. Modeling Q2 without a mana cost would understate Syndra's mana expenditure in any rotation that spends both charges.

If the level-11 baseline instead carries Q at rank 4, both this leaf and its sibling /Q/resource_cost would read 55.0; the invariant that survives either way is Q2.resource_cost == Q.resource_cost, which <absent> violates.
